items.caption: This small-seal form of 西 has a rounded enclosure with crossing strokes inside and a long descending stroke on the right. It shows a later script tradition; its shape does not resolve the graph’s disputed origin.
items.alt: Black seal-script 西 on white, with crossing strokes inside a rounded enclosure and a long descending stroke on the right.
items.selection_reason: The image visibly shows the identified small-seal form, giving readers a reference for a later script stage. The graphic-history evidence labels small seal as one stage, while competing accounts of the graph’s origin remain unresolved.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector reconstruction, not a dated artifact. The evidence does not give a precise date for this form or resolve whether 西 originated as a nest image, was borrowed for “west,” acquired that sense through the sunset association, or reflects another proposal.
